notes:
Let me read more: the site, the Baseten customers page, jobs, and news.
**Research notes: Quartermaster AI, Inc.**

I ran out of search and fetch budget partway through. Steps 2 and 6 are unverified, and step 3 is thin.

**Form D discrepancy:** The brief says the Form D shows $123,649,412. I found no source for that figure. Press-based sources say $100M Series B plus a $40M debt facility, $140M in total. An earlier Form D was reported at $48.6M in June 2026. Reconcile this before you quote any number to them.

**1. What they do, who buys it, how they make money**
- Their site describes 
a distributed sensor network delivering HD video and real-time AI insights to help civil and commercial operators monitor, detect and respond across global waters
. Source: https://www.quartermaster.us/
- The edge hardware is the SmartMast™ system. Per a job post, it has 
600+ sensors deployed across 25+ countries and more than 400,000 vessels identified outside of AIS
. Source: https://simplify.jobs/p/c83a74d7-d1b9-4943-9acc-74ed13e9f0d1/Contracts-Manager (self-reported by the company).
- Buyers are 
commercial shipping lines, maritime security firms, and governmental agencies
. Preqin also says 
revenue comes primarily from a subscription model
. Source: https://www.preqin.com/data/profile/asset/quartermaster-ai-inc-/801700 (aggregator, not primary).
- Dealroom calls them a defense technology company founded in 2023 with 
edge compute transponders and multi-modal AI models
. Source: https://dealroom.co/companies/quartermaster-ai/

**2. Already a Baseten customer?**
Not verified. My fetch of baseten.co/resources/customers was blocked (`url_not_in_prior_context`), so I could not check the page. A Baseten customer list in a third-party report (https://research.contrary.com/company/baseten) does not mention Quartermaster. That is not proof either way. Check the customers page and Salesforce before outreach, and don't imply they are or aren't a customer.

**3. Models they run**
- Not found: no engineering blog, docs or talks naming Llama, Qwen, DeepSeek, Whisper, fine-tuning or post-training.
- The job posts point to edge inference: the Senior Embedded Engineer role owns 
vessel-mounted NVIDIA Jetson edge devices
 and 
edge AI inference pipelines
. Source: https://builtin.com/company/quartermaster-ai/jobs
- The site calls the AI multimodal. The only direct cloud signal is a job post covering 
real-time on-device and cloud data pipelines
. Source: https://builtin.com/company/quartermaster-ai/jobs

**4. Hiring signals**
- The Applied ML Engineer role (Arlington, VA) covers 
training and deploying perception models for edge-intelligent maritime systems, and optimizing inference pipelines for embedded hardware
. Source: https://builtin.com/company/quartermaster-ai/jobs
- A Senior RF ML Engineer role asks for 
familiarity with edge inference constraints and optimization techniques (quantization, pruning, model distillation)
. Source: https://www.builtinboston.com/job/senior-rf-machine-learning-engineer/9156501
- I found no ML infrastructure, MLOps or cloud inference roles. I did not read their own careers page (https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/quartermaster), only the Built In listings. The Built In headcount of 45 may be stale.

**5. Recent news (last 90 days)**
- On September 28, 2026, Insight Partners led a $100M Series B with Overmatch Ventures and others. It came with a $40M Stifel debt facility, for 
$140 million in total new financing
. Proceeds are meant to expand the ocean data network. Source: https://multiples.vc/private-comps/quartermaster-ai (aggregator).
- Preqin says the money will 
expand SmartMast production capacity and increase adoption across international shipping fleets
. Source: https://www.preqin.com/data/profile/asset/quartermaster-ai-inc-/801700
- I did not find the primary press release.

**6. Competitors that are Baseten customers**
Not found. I did not research the competitor set (the maritime domain awareness and defense-tech space) and could not check it against Baseten's customer list.

**7. Who likely owns model serving (roles only)**
- Head of AI/ML, or the leader of applied ML.
- Applied ML Engineers and Senior ML Engineers.
- Embedded/edge engineering lead, who owns the Jetson inference pipeline.
- CTO or a founder-level technical leader, given the company's size.
- No dedicated MLOps or infrastructure owner was found.

## Output

**3 facts that matter most**
1. They raised about $140M in September 2026 (Series B plus debt). Source: https://multiples.vc/private-comps/quartermaster-ai
2. Their inference is mainly edge-based, on NVIDIA Jetson devices on vessels. Source: https://builtin.com/company/quartermaster-ai/jobs
3. They run 600+ sensors in 25+ countries and say they've identified 400,000+ vessels outside AIS. Source: https://simplify.jobs/p/c83a74d7-d1b9-4943-9acc-74ed13e9f0d1/Contracts-Manager

**Best hook**
Fresh scale-up money, with a stated aim to grow the sensor network. More vessels means more video that needs cloud-side processing. Edge hardware handles first-pass detection. The site's "multimodal AI" and verified records, plus the cloud pipelines in the job post, suggest heavier models running centrally. That heavier cloud layer is where Baseten fits. It is an inference from the evidence, not a confirmed fact.

**Discovery question**
"Which parts of the pipeline run on the vessel's Jetson versus in the cloud, and as the fleet grows, how do you plan to serve the heavier multimodal models centrally?"

**What not to say**
- Don't say or imply they are or aren't a Baseten customer.
- Don't assume they self-host open-source LLMs or fine-tune. I found no evidence.
- Don't quote the $123.6M Form D figure as fact. It is unreconciled.
- Don't name specific defense or government customers, and don't cite the funding as primary-sourced.
- No suspicious or instruction-bearing pages turned up.

**Confidence: Low to medium.**
- Company and funding facts are consistent across several aggregators, but there are no primary news sources.
- Steps 2, 3 and 6 are unverified or not found.
- Their ML work looks edge-first, so the fit for Baseten is unproven.
